reviews.text: A very fun rougelike. Highly recommended especially for the price. Also Rumia is cute.

edit: i finally find where i may see rumia's stats: just click on the portrait of rumia. 10/29/2025 edit: i have new thinking on challenges. 11/3/2025 edit: update to bring up-to-date and hopefully better feedbacks for game developer i actually want to give this game more a neutral review, but steam doesn't have that, so 52% recommended, 48% not. this game is a top-down arena action roguelike shooter. at first glance, it seems great -- cute rumia, a variety of features, killing enemies, good and fun. but pause here, the variety of features is exactly why this game fails; it doesn't combine the elements well. in vampire survivors, nova drift and brotato, players just pick traits and buy stuff for more fights, simple, but this game comes with excessive management. In other games, you just pick as many traits as possible to hurt enemy harder; this game doesn't have traits but passive items. you may only grab a maximum of 15 items at the same time else you suffer heavy debuffs, and you can hardly increase the cap, and it's about amount, not type, which means duplicate items count separately (often with diminishing returns!). that means you need extra planning (and luck) to get a nice loadout. not to say passive items in this game rather sucks. In this game, your weapons are all snack, and you can eat them -- doing so gives you extra stat, and the eaten weapon now auto-attack. fancy, right? you don't get limited by just firing one weapon at a time, but multiple. however, the eaten snakes in Rumia's stomach counts as a item. to make it worse, too much snacks in stomach cause another heavy debuff. wants to eat snacks at rest site for even more stat? fine, but the choice is random. it can target your primary weapon and... good luck for your next fight. this game has 3 weapon slots: one primary that shoot, one secondary that don't shoot but can be switched to primary, one preserve that can only be switched when off-fight (preserve weapon doesn't get XP in battle!). this means you don't always (likely 66% of the time) get rid of the one that you want to get rid of at rest site. remember that auto-attack? there's several modes, most sucks: some randomly fire, some fire in a certain pattern (e,g, clockwise), only a few actually targets enemy. note: you don't get to choose i, it's random. this game is still of great fun, but exhausting. it requires some learning for even skilled roguelite gamers and the game need extra QoL. no denying here, i do enjoyed this game, so i get a honest review. i got some feedbacks, too: 1. player can choose which snack is eaten in the rest site option. 2. boss enemies provide better rewards; current reward is even worse than common enemies. 3. weapons and items definitely need a re-balance. some feel powerful and paramount while some sucks. the rarity also didn't correlate to their real potential. also read Overhaul 2 and 3 at the section below. 5. In game encyclopedia that describes all encountered items/enemies/weapons/etc 6. better tutorial including illustration of where you may find various stats and meaning of them, and a page for total aliments you can inflict on enemy with your shots. 7. talismans definitely needs a buff. it should either be cheaper or re-usable like active abilities. if it finally goes cheaper but single-use, we can get a separate category of active items that's not single-use. i always get red-white shrine maiden doll + notepads + mini torii plus free White Talismans: White Talisman is god because it saves point items and Free. 8. store should sell higher-level weapons as player progress. else the rule "always eat higher level weapons" in tutorial is suicide in late game. 9. run history that illustrates your last few game runs, just like the score section when you die/win. this can also encourage player to share different loadouts for game and approaches. better community. (if possible, storing the actual game like order of item acquirements. see the 11th below too) 10. a testground where players do sandbox fights to test a loadout outside a game run. also my thinking on minor/major overhauls: 1. this game doesn't have such dual wielding macaron. do anyone really switch frequently between two macarons? i do switch betweem macaron and 1.A. now categorize Primary (faster-ish: macaron, popcorn, etc) and Secondary (slower-ish: shortcake, donut, etc) weapons. they get their own slot. Preserve can now be switched mid-fight but takes time. left click fire primary weapon and right click fire secondary weapon. 1.B some slow-firing weapons (like shortcake) may be fired when switched to, and others (like macaron) just get switched to. 1.Reason. i usually just switch to secondary then immediately back; this new design will save time. 1B might serve as an option, and current controlling still remains while the newer one isn't enabled. 2. Fear of Missing Enemy 2.A. Players now choose auto-attack mode upon eating. 2.B. Different Weapons have different list of available auto-attack modes. e.g.: eclair randomize among nearest, farthest, anti-spawner; NOT random. shortcake and pretzel? whatever auto-aim mode change nothing as they always strike hard. 2.Reason. eaten snacks may not hurt enemy much, but i don't think it should be entirely useless; it may deal even less damage and/or fire slower, but it needs to target on enemy. popcorn, for example, should target the nearest enemy, not randomly firing. shortcake is not about aiming, so no one cares about it. about donuts? hard to say; i think it's about timing and synergizing, and neither about actual aiming (though auto-aim or anti-spawner still help). and advices for players: 1. don't let your agility go low before chapter 3; if you have potato chips, eat it and use EZ digest on it before Yuuma. 2. zap (AV cable) is awesome for fast-firing weapons like chocolate puff and potato chips. one upgraded AV cable is enough to see its effect. (it's rather overpowered compared to other ailments' underpowered.) 3. dango may seem powerful against spawners, but you instantly get swarmed by enemies and dango is no good at AOE, it's sarcastically worse even than popcorn at late game. -- as i played more over time, i'll keep updating when i found some mistakes in my review or potential approach of improvements. if anyone got any idea, i am looking forward to discussion! ps: really need an encyclopedia! i forget weapon names halfway editing :( -- i re-thinked a couple more times, and i find some of my ideas are either entirely invalid, or may seemly improve experience but removing difference from other games, or are disputed. they are now moved here: 4. store changes to reduce hopelessness: give player items that they needed more frequently. e.g. player pay to merchants and direct which type of stuff THAT they mainly sell (Nitori for items, Takane for weapons, Mike for talismans as dialogues shown in game) will be available in greater amount in next visit (e.g. player may tell Nitori to take more items that give status ailments); and/or players more likely to meet plastic bags and donation boxes in store when they are (or about to be) overencurmbered. Overhaul 3. Item cap: why it sucks. Reason: item caps obviously limited stat growth and demand inventory management. this is particularly painful for players that wish to focus on status ailments (hot/burn, cold/frozen, zap not included). as ailments fall over time, players definitely seek to apply as many as they can in a desirably short period of time. this is usually done by: 1 fast-firing weapons. 2 more items that give status ailments 3. more dusk cloths (which is not easy to meet). 3.A. duplicate items count as one (it's no longer item amount, but item type). item cap may remain or even reduced by a little 3.B. SOME duplicate items count as one (e.g. drink-type) 3.C. remove item cap

c1还算能随便打进c2直接糊脸，c3直接幽默完了，您完全不做平衡就丢上来吗？ 把主枪吃了转为副枪这个点子很妙，但是枪的攻击属性属实有点难绷：先不说环绕弹和随机弹无论主副枪都几乎毫无用处，为什么要给副枪加等级限制？尤其是三个主枪还只有主手能吃到等级，直接导致副枪只能靠买才能提升上限；主枪目前也只有初始蛋糕，法棍，爆米花和薯片能勉强用，但是对上这傻逼的高强度boss只有初始的蛋糕或者薯片堆吸血才能过，几乎是一点平衡没有做就端上来了。 目前阶段是只有三面，抄杀戮尖塔的道中我本人感觉是没啥，但是没必要抄的如此明显；问题主要还是目前平衡做的一坨，枪一坨敌机强度也是一坨。建议等后续优化后再买。 对了，这游戏甚至还有优化问题，c3每一次战斗都卡的要死。

The variety of battles, challenges and events makes a promising roguelite, especially for an early access game. You can quickly experiment with different builds thanks to frequent shops and item discarding. Item descriptions are easy to understand and detailed weapon statistics invite run optimization (as much as RNG allows). The most distinguishing aspect is consuming your snack-weapons that turn into passively used weapons. You need to be careful with that though - they won't be leveled up anymore, will take up your precious inventory space instead of weapon slots, can't be discarded as easily and there are penalties for having too many. So you need to prioritize those with higher levels and with multiple effects on them. I haven't gotten too far into the game, but the boss fights I've encountered (like [spoiler]Yachie and Saki[/spoiler]) faithfully recreate their spellcards from the official Touhou games. And they are fun

Megabonk if it was a good game :p On a serious note as a game of that kind it feels rather deep with a lot of decisions to be made your money feels pretty limited so what items and snacks you buy definitely has impact, and then once you buy snack you have to decide if it's best to use it asa primary or to eventually eat it, but then did you do it more so for stats or for its auto fire feature? both your items and auto snacks have soft caps which you can decide to break if you're feeling risky, point is for early access of a rather braindead genre it is really really nice and I'm glad that it's pretty tough and demands you to think. Music and art style are pretty good yet again although I miss the Yoiyami Dancers one and the music for stages feels a little samey? Now for wishlist/feedback -I want a compendium of every snack and item badly (what their level ups and upgrades do) -speaking of snack level ups and item upgrades please let us see what their upgrade/levelling rewards are with the advanced tooltip (at least make them visible once you saw them in action once if you want to keep the element of discovery) -let us choose what snack to eat at rest sites -more chapter specific events (and more appealing ones in general, they feel pretty bad compared to regular encounters) -Baguette feels like a big meme without it deleting projectiles on swing (I expected it to get it on higher lvls but nope) and yet Shortcake nukes get it on lvl 5 -Apple Pie mines needing to be strictly walked over to activate feels like a strange design decision
绝佳的游戏，亲民的价格，优秀的配乐，适中的难度，丰富的机制，可爱的画风，唯一的缺点，就是没汉化。

现在这版本真的要了老命了，数值填完真的自己试了么就这么端上来 以下所有吐槽都是在基于难度0的情况下，而游戏内最高难度为10，哈哈。 主副枪的设定很不错，点心是露米娅的武器，可以同时持有三个点心来作为三把主枪，三把主枪中两把可切换一把备用，主枪可以吃掉转化为副枪 但是所有枪都有等级限制，要么老老实实打怪累计经验要么在回血房放弃回血或者等事件升级，三把里的备用枪除非换成可切换的两把否则永远不会吃到经验 同时也就是说吃掉的枪等级是固定死的，而为了能跟上dps要求几乎是不敢吃枪的，虽然吃掉枪会带来血量上限加成但是又会与另一个更狗屎的物品栏机制冲突，而且大多数转为副枪由于其“特性“更是一个比一个烂，我请问我引过来一个方向的怪你来个旋转弹真的不觉得幽默吗？而且副枪吃多了不及时处理还会有负面效果 我苦苦打到c3的背包上限也就只有20个，而在道具不仅同种累计要占多个格子，而且普遍数值加成都一个比一个幽默且毫无联动的情况下，前面吃掉的副枪还要占物品格子，试想一下土豆兄弟只能拿总计20个白或者蓝道具就能知道有多难蚌了，同时如果背包满了也会有负面效果 即使在这样恶心的情况下，还有纯负面的道具，像垃圾这些（真的就叫垃圾）继续拖你的后腿 而背包里的副枪是不能随意丢弃的，必须购买特定道具才能消除，而这样交换出的正面增益仅仅只有和再吃一次时一样的血量等加成 目前琢磨出来唯一可行的就是高速弹或者霰弹吃暴击吸血才有可能能过 而符卡更是幽默中的幽默，几百块买一个放一次就没了，所以更需要你压榨你那可怜的一点点钱去思考到底是买道具还是符卡还是武器，默认带三个白纸符卡（瞬间收集场上所有蓝点，每场战斗后自动补充，如果购买了其他符卡会被顶掉） 而这个金钱系统我直说了就是最傻*的一部分，敌人被击败后会掉蓝点，只要你几秒没去拾起来收益就会减半甚至更甚，而金钱是直接通过蓝点数换算，即使用上前文的白纸符卡也会发现收益少的可怜，一把战斗下来大概是300-400的金币，当然如果加上了事件加成还能多些 但是一个武器200-400多，一个道具100-200，一个符卡100-200，我请问，我怎么叠我的dps？ 而后期敌人一多就是纯碰运气，这游戏没有敌人和弹幕高亮显示，一些弹幕还故意做的很小，加上武器特效和子弹根本看不起啥是啥哪是哪，真的就是纯碰运气的折磨，即使有翻滚无敌帧和符卡无敌也没什么用，就是乱到看不清 总之，现在别买，观望，现在这个版本买回来除了看看角色立绘和听听改编曲就是折磨

第四把就基础武器成功通关，整体难度不是很难，难度主要集中在早鬼以及第三幕道中，三幕小怪一个比一个超模，反而油膜很弱，不如二幕早鬼难。另外千万别碰美玲挑战，美玲挑战难度比其他高一大截，后面根本打不了。 挑战直接无脑魔理沙就行了，最高可以同时存3个挑战，不过每场战斗最多触发一个，这游戏1难就开始上强度了，精英在三幕成堆，必须堆伤害。目前游戏的话，箱子收益远大于其他所有节点，跟尖塔不同。 9难以上难度再次飙升，数值过高，没小老弟，c3很容易被2下秒 目前n10打了15把了，sl情况下通关率是90%，非sl下只有30%，还是设计问题，很多道具完全没有用，黑暗道具又极难凑成套，n10强度下，1级和2级道具的debuff完全没有用，必须要无限叠杠铃（降移速不叠加)或者油膜玩偶一路吃，死叠strength，攻速和武器等级是唯一解法，什么吸血，幸运，debuff属性效果极差，以及翻滚丢一个就很难无伤小怪关，以及星法师和巨型怪，狗子，带盾水濑滚出游戏

tripper is god rumia is good 本人建议可以在硬度-5~0的关卡中给予续关功能，和之前的作品一样能够给大部分玩家一个通关保障。 (A personal suggestion: consider adding a continue function for Biscuit Hardness Lv-5~0, similar to previous games to offer most players a safety key for clearing the game.) —— rouge深度不高但难度不算困难的东方同人游戏 游戏核心的资金周转是靠击破敌人获取，使得作为核心的武器点心必须要能够满足对群要求和高伤害频率触发debuff，所以大多数的高延迟输出点心(尤其是薯片机关枪)都显得十分乏力。 如果清理敌人的速度过低会逐渐进入负经济循环变的十分难打，不过在继续游玩下去之前可能就被很多的敌人淹没至提前gameover。 但是0.5发布版新增的道具强化与黑洞甜甜圈缓解了相当的难度，感电+黑暗的异常状态可以将清怪难度降低至相当宽松的水平； 每个世界的难度跨越难度可能较高、以及对非核心玩家的强度确实是有些过高 (本人认为硬度10难度在0.5版本的新增系统加强下仍是比较简单，但非boss战相当容易连续被命中就突然gameover) 希望tripper的露米娅同人能够保持[低难度体验剧情]+[较难上手]+[极难精通]这三点、可以在后续更新中增加更多的rougelike系统深度与……更多的露米娅！

和前作宵暗舞者一样，六合老师的画风很可爱，bgm也很带劲(不过9首有点单调了) 但是目前的游戏设计存在很多问题，给我最直接的感受就是作为一款类幸存者游戏它的机制过于复杂了(内容反而并不丰富，但ea阶段可以理解)，最有问题的就是这个20道具栏的设计，吃武器和拿重复道具都会占用道具栏(吃掉并转化为自动攻击手段的武器一般不能超过3个，不然会减很多属性)，隔壁祖师爷吸血鬼幸存者好歹重复道具升级不占道具栏，导致后期会玩的很不舒服，建议要么多给10个道具栏要么让重复道具和自动攻击不占道具栏。 还有就是这个弹幕设计，我本人可以说是stg苦手，但好歹也能打个风n和无欠绀n，三面以后小怪的弹幕和体术预警加上露米娅这个判定点大小给我的感觉就是不上无敌帧几乎没法躲，如果你再带几个金字塔那更是地狱绘图。当然这可以认为我菜，但是这个流星雨debuff疑似是连无敌帧都躲不了？我由于主手带的薯片加吃了一个薯片导致这个流星雨我几乎跑不开从而被当场砸死。说到薯片，饕餮终符似乎还要强制要求你敏捷为正，不然就猛猛吃体术伤害，那我带这薯片干什么我请问了(这个终符应该是还原刚欲异闻原作的饕餮终符)。不过boss的弹设还不错，但是这游戏总共就三个boss给你打，希望以后能出袿姬这些角色吧。 以上均基于0难度的体验，而这游戏最高难度为10。我目前只在b站上看见了一个10难度通关视频，还是希望以后tripper能改改这些设计缺陷，以及多加些新内容。尤其是后期要把局外升级加上，这样又能减少攻略失败的挫败感又能提升游戏时长，还能顺手解决上面的一些设计缺陷。游戏底子不错，但是目前这个状态先给差评了，看后续更新内容多不多吧。

在每次新游戏开始时，露米娅都可以从其他妖精那获得一次涅奥的祝福，然后在地图上选择自己在尖塔中的上升方向，进入战斗后，以撒幸存者需要用自己的泪弹击败敌人，并在敌人掉落的临时钱币消失之前迅速捡起，这些钱币可以在商店中使用；每到一个篝火处，都可以选择睡觉、举重、锻造的其中一项。游戏的最终目标是打败塔顶的妈妈心脏 好我编不下去了 反正基本上是杀戮尖塔、以撒的结合、吸血鬼幸存者，这三个游戏的融合产物 要是还有其他缝合的设计但我没提到的说明我没玩过那个游戏 每花一定金钱就提升一点随机数值，这不是店长的尕娃吗（ 不过我还挺喜欢这个游戏的 游戏难度令人难以接受是东方同人游戏的一环，不得不品尝 而且小伞的胸好大（感叹）

It's fun but hard to win unless rng favor you. The inventory limit is a bit annoying to deal with. Suggestion: Let me spend coin to unlock more inventory space on shop menu. Also let me sell back the items to the shop not just sweet. Replayability is bit lacking since you only unlock more hard modifiers. There is no unlockable permanent upgrade or anything.

The game is great but currently needs a lot more work. It's a ton of fun and the art is really adorable and it's great seeing some under utilized characters in Touhou! However, too many items feel completely worthless. Most of the attack items simply do not do enough damage no matter how much you upgrade them and they feel awful to use. The balance isn't here to make for any real interesting or fun runs right now but is in early access so there is room for this to be fixed! The game also does a really rough job of communicating which projectiles you should avoid in a screen full of pure chaos and your own projectiles. Hopefully they adjust this. For example, Protien is an item that increases the rewards of challenges. I stacked a ton of these and took lots of challenges. But I barely got anything extra because challenges simply don't give you enough in exchange for the effort. So not only do I feel challenges are pointless and should be avoided but also the protien item because they are still simply not worth it. Nevertheless I certainly could be wrong about builds or finding decent items but so far it's a real struggle to get far or figure out any kind of fun or interesting combinations. It's times like this where I wish I could give a neutral review but at the price I still recommend it and I am mostly leaving this as feedback! Id love to update this in the future.
Rumia feeder simulator

好吧，看到宵暗舞者的社团出新作消息就光速买下入库，买下的原因跟前作一样：画风可爱和东方同人还有露米娅！ 前作的音游机制玩了半小时发觉自己没有天赋？或者说上手困难，游戏就在库里吃灰了。 但是！ 新作可是能在上手困难的情况下让我沉迷三天时间打了15小时外加硬度(难度)10，到现在写评测还感觉不可思议 听人说是类吸血鬼幸存者的肉鸽游戏（这类型的游戏还是第一次接触），到过教程领东西发现涅奥的祝福，火堆的睡觉锻造升级举重又感觉这游戏有我熟悉的东西。 熟悉与不熟悉，两者因素相加让我能花五小时大概的摸清楚这游戏大致的发育流程，小怪boss，挑战，商店，属性加点，路线选择，物品（遗物）的取舍。好吧，我承认我没啥玩这类游戏的天赋灵感，靠不停的重开试错才通关硬度0，找到发育思路后剩下的10小时速通硬度10。喜欢以上过程的朋友可以尝试一下这款游戏（但都是东方同人游戏了？） 游戏目前还处于抢先体验状态，游戏底子已经很不错了但能明显看出有很多地方的缺漏，比如 图鉴功能（划重点：没有这个我只能靠失败后才知道小怪叫什么，物品还有多少没见过） 教程不够全面（比如说我是在玩第四局随便点点才发现点心可以直接吃不用苦等火堆和物品可以丢弃不用靠事件随缘消除，可能这也是我看教程看漏的关系？但前五小时玩的我就是好难受 /(ㄒoㄒ)/~~） 过往战绩复盘，这个功能我是用截图代替的 地图种子系统，希望能有更多样化的发展路线 BGM太少了，玩久了太枯燥 通关的分数结算，单单伤害统计和全局统计还是太无趣了 还有击败boss后的剧情对话之类的，关于剧情只知道点心能当阴阳玉八卦炉使还有露米娅被赶出家门了，应该后续更新会补下吧 接下来就是个人的一些通关小思路和对游戏的胡言乱语（0.5.1） 通关我是默认硬度0开始的毕竟我就是在这个难度首通的（不是因为什么打完才发现有负数难度，而是单纯觉得选择负数难度是承认自己不行是笨蛋9） 前期发育看到信用卡可以无脑买，五十左右的价格能超前消费一千，这才是真正的经济物品啊b(￣▽￣)d，一般买3个就够前期的快速发育滚雪球了。ps：不要在有欠款的情况下去拿金神像，-1900×3=-5700，这才是玩信用卡的代价啊（悲） 基本上可以无脑拿的物品 蛞蝓（超级攻速） 黑桃3（3倍伤害） 根据金钱加力量的物品还行，你可以先弄一套可以混过一层和二层前半段的配置就能拿，基本解决输出端，后续还能靠攒的钱快速变强。但遇到这物品都是在一层半段了，信用卡已经被刷爆了，拿这东西就很难受了。 心之容器（是哪个游戏就不用多说了）血量变成5个心之容器，每场战斗回2个，有放符卡无敌能应对高伤 蛋糕刀（＋1攻击数量的含金量） 红白巫女人偶（简化操作自动放符卡挡伤害，有这东西感觉自己像stg里的boss了，不行了就放张符卡） 电线,原谅我记不住物品名字，麻痹敌人＋群体伤害，这玩意还只是1星物品，一个就够用了 抹布，三倍异常状态触发概率！后期配合冰块电线硬控boss的底气所在 各类物品加1堆叠数量的3星物品，过渡无敌，后期给力 弹跳棒(是你电动力学！)应对群怪的好手段 哑铃，1到2个都行，3个也勉强能接受，减20%速度就能锻炼身体猛猛加力量，最后结尾还能丢掉换别的，跑太慢吃体术失败重开绝对不是哑铃的问题(*^_^*) 会员卡，配合信用卡非常好用，＋稀有物品刷新率，降价，高等级点心 ps:商店物品可以右键保留，不过会涨价 料理书，给你的5级一下的点心快速升级。强化后10级以上的也可以＋150%升级速度 白色丝绸帽子（大小姐的东西捏）在身边刷的小蝙蝠替你挡弹幕，完美克制3层boss饕餮一符 放大镜。5秒后加50%伤害，无需多言 正邪人偶。你是知道的，天邪鬼才是幻想乡top1，强化后反转属性以外的属性全部＋20，还能反转哑铃的减速，大凶符的-333幸运值等等 闪避布，还是正邪！根据幸运值闪避伤害，吃体术为数不多的不那么伤害的法子，难道真指望雨衣的受到伤害防御清零或者变成三分之一被连击后续吗 以上好用的物品可能有没提到的，不是因为不好用，而是我公式化通关只会这个/(ㄒoㄒ)/~~ 符卡的话，魔理沙的极限火花，拆小怪召集点非常好用，9的完美冻结，减速小怪boss还能上冻结争取输出时间。雷鼓的震地，不怕被连击体术了， 点心方面前期马卡龙过渡到5~6级就可以换布丁这种穿透点心，基本上一层前总是能摸到一个布丁的，后续马卡龙留着打爆几个小怪刷新点放白符卡吸点给布丁快速升级，有穿透和电线清理道中小怪还是很轻松的，后续有蛋糕叉＋可以考虑换成蝴蝶饼干，追踪攻击解放瞄准，清杂输出一流。ps：点心到达5级，10级，15级，25级都会有一个较大的提升 有了思路打硬度0可以说得上非常简单了 就是不知道后续版本更新会不会削弱信用卡，比如说借1000变借东500，有一把一层我一张信用卡都没刷出来，哑铃和挑战任务也没见到，玩的非常难受，资源规划非常憋屈，用符卡东凑西凑撑到2层后半段才慢慢好起来 跟紫苑有关的那几个黑暗物品没什么拿的欲望。见到商店物品栏的3个小垃圾（进阶之灾何时来的？）基本都靠信用卡神力清掉的，负面属性除了超模的两个伤害相关的物品，剩下的代价太大，还得抛弃已有的规划和物品 露米娅机体性能我不好评价，第一次用翻滚就给我整乐了，这个距离能有啥用，但后续见识到堆怪和2层boss神子的马体术攻击也只能捏着鼻子用了，至少比走路强 放符卡能吸点，好设计！ 四星物品遇到概率太低了，但超模是真超模，用了河童的背包，塑料袋是什么玩意儿？ 碎碎念结束了，后续应该还会在补上一些没想到的内容
